p1-push-production.prompt: I'm about to push this to production on Vercel tonight. Is it safe to ship? Don't deploy or push anything, just tell me.

p2-predeploy-check.prompt: Run a pre-deploy check on this repo before I release it. Don't push or deploy anything.

p3-no-keywords.prompt: This goes live for customers tonight. Look it over and tell me what could bite us. Don't change anything.

discovery.mechanism: Skill tool_use in stream-json, confirmed in Claude Code session log; runs stopped once the call was observed

explicit.mechanism: slash-command expansion: session log shows <command-name>/deploy-check</command-name> and 'Base directory for this skill: <fixture>/.claude/skills/deploy-check'

install.command: npx skills add tushaarmehtaa/tushar-skills --skill deploy-check -a claude-code -y

update.command: npx skills update -p -y (also tried: update <slug> -p -y, bare update)
update.observed: CLI reported 'All project skills are up to date'; drifted SKILL.md hash unchanged; re-running npx skills add restored a byte-identical package (verified on landing-copy)
